from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as reported")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock market security code if provided")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this financial data")
    revenue: float | None = Field(description="Total revenue/营业收入 for the reporting period in yuan")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the revenue figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
